gulliver.config.title: Gulliver Settings
gulliver.config.dyeResizing.tooltip: Right-click cyan or purple dye, or a red or brown mushroom, to shrink or grow.
gulliver.config.karmaMode.tooltip: Dying resets your size to your starting size.
gulliver.config.grapple.tooltip: A tiny angler's fishing rod bobber bites into walls, ceilings and floors; reel in to be pulled up to it.
gulliver.config.grappleMaxSize.tooltip: The largest size whose fishing rod works as a grappling hook.
gulliver.config.trample.tooltip: Anything walking over a creature smaller than this share of its own size tramples it.
gulliver.config.spawn.tooltip: A size (0.5), a range (0.5-2), a list to pick from (0.5,1,2), or for players a height (5'9", 175cm).
gulliver.config.limitAll.tooltip: The range every creature lives in, from 1/32 to 32 times normal size. The limits below can only narrow it. Anything outside 1/8 to 8 is experimental.
gulliver.config.limitClass.tooltip: Limit for this kind of creature. Default follows the range for everyone.
gulliver.config.lootScaling.tooltip: Big mobs drop more loot and small ones less.
gulliver.config.giantBossBars.tooltip: Mobs at size 4 and above show a boss bar to players nearby.
gulliver.config.tinyMounts.tooltip: Tinies can ride small animals such as chickens, cats, wolves, foxes and rabbits.
gulliver.config.screenShake.tooltip: How strongly the screen shakes when something huge walks past or lands. Vanilla's Damage Tilt option applies on top.
gulliver.config.smoothResize.tooltip: Animate size changes on screen. Your hitbox still changes at once.
gulliver.config.sizeReadout.tooltip: Show your new size on the action bar whenever it changes.
gulliver.config.heldItems.tooltip: Classic: items look bigger the smaller you are, as in the original mod. Proportional: items stay in proportion to your body.
gulliver.config.note.limits: Sizes outside 1/8 to 8 are experimental: expect odd physics, lag and glitches. More: config/gulliver.json
gulliver.config.note.server: You are on a server: its own settings decide gameplay. These apply to worlds you open yourself.
